root.title: Machine Learning and Data Science
root.summary: An overview of data science methodologies, machine learning paradigms, and analytical tools used to derive insights from data.
key_points: AI is the umbrella; Machine Learning is a branch of AI.
Data Science builds models and interprets data for decision-making.
Data Analysis focuses on summarizing past and present insights.

children.title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
children.summary: The initial step of inspecting, cleaning, and visualizing data to understand features and connections.
key_points: Univariate: Studying one variable (mean, median, mode, variance, std dev).
Bivariate: Studying relationships between two variables (correlations, dependencies).
Multivariate: Studying relationships between two or more variables.

children.title: Machine Learning Paradigms
children.summary: Types of learning models used to solve complex problems and discover hidden patterns.
key_points: Clustering: Finds hidden patterns or groupings (K-Means, Hierarchical, DBSCAN).
Regression: Predicts continuous values (Simple/Multiple Linear, Decision Tree, Random Forest, SVR).
Classification: Predicts categories (Logistic Regression).
Reinforcement Learning: Learns via environment interaction and rewards (Q-Learning, DQN).

children.title: Dimensionality Reduction
children.summary: Techniques to reduce the number of variables in a dataset while maintaining relevant information.
key_points: Feature Selection: Selecting important features via statistical tests or importance scores (SelectKBest, RFE).
Feature Extraction: Creating new features (PCA, LDA, t-SNE).
PCA: Linear technique using orthogonal variables ordered by variance.
LDA: Classification-based technique for labeled data.
t-SNE: Used for visualization, clustering, and high-dimensional data.

children.title: Data Tools and Libraries
children.summary: Software and coding libraries essential for data analysis and machine learning tasks.
key_points: Python Libraries: Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-Learn.
Analytical Tools: Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau.
Pandas: Used for big data analysis, cleaning, and statistical summaries (correlation, min/max/mean).

children.title: Recommender Systems
children.summary: Systems that recommend items based on user preferences, behavior, or interactions.
key_points: Content-Based Filtering: Recommends items similar to past likes using item attributes (TF-IDF, Cosine Similarity).
Collaborative Filtering: Analyzes user interactions and behaviors.
Commonly used in E-commerce, Streaming, and Social Media.
